name: hash
description: Cryptographic hashing (SHA-256) and password verification helper (PBKDF2) using native Web Crypto API.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when hashing strings, generating cryptographic check-sums, or securely storing and verifying user passwords without bringing in heavy native libraries like bcrypt.

parameters.name: salt
parameters.description: Optional hex salt. Will be randomly generated if not provided.
